name: cyclin dependent kinase inhibitor 2C

function.text: CDKN2C encodes cyclin-dependent kinase 4 inhibitor C. Annotated molecular activities include cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase inhibitor activity and protein kinase binding. It participates in oligodendrocyte differentiation and negative regulation of cell growth.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Burkitt Lymphoma; Low-Grade Glioma, NOS. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
